findings.issue: Apify discovery returns Decimal in max_total_charge_usd; successful paid results fail JSON persistence.
The guard wraps automatic transport retries: multiple billable POSTs share one reservation, including Apify Actor creation after a lost response.
Open Notebook replacement deletes the existing source before the budget guard can refuse the replacement.
Notification CLI commands return before loading project/root .env, silently ignoring configured hard-stop budgets.
New live guard calls a reservation check whose SELECTs run before a write transaction; concurrent workers can both spend the same remaining budget.
Strict-mode parsing disagrees on surrounding whitespace, and positive sub-micro-dollar caps truncate to zero and disable enforcement.
Unknown attempts are counted in both usage and outstanding reservations, incorrectly rejecting work that still fits the budget.
Unusable Bright Data responses containing words such as quota are treated as known failures and settle reservations despite having no usable snapshot ID.
A local submission-marker write failure before any transport leaves a permanent unknown charge and outstanding reservation.
MiniMax successful responses are recorded before consuming provider usage; default calls report zero output tokens despite returned usage.
New clear=True test environments remove USERNAME, breaking real Windows private-directory ACL checks; the full suite fails before exercising recovery.
Outstanding reservations disappear from the live guard's risk calculation at a period boundary even though unknown remote work remains unresolved.
The SQLite connection context commits but does not close the handle, so Windows recovery tests fail during TemporaryDirectory cleanup with WinError 32.

RSS queue root binding now precedes cloud-permission validation; the built-in offline self-test's rejection fixture has no root and raises AttributeError instead of exercising the authorization refusal.

summary: Found and locally fixed 14 actionable defects in retry accounting, atomic budget enforcement, recovery/persistence, side-effect ordering, CLI configuration, and Windows/self-test verification. Failing regressions were captured before fixes; final Git Bash validation passed 244 Python tests and 30 widget scenarios, with 11 Python tests skipped. No push or live paid-provider calls were performed; provider billing and historical unlinked unknown reservations still require external/manual reconciliation.
